blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion-based denoising commonly uses Gaussian perturbations, whereas sensor noise follows diverse signal-dependent statistical laws. In this paper, we propose $p$-Bridge, a unified measurement-indexed diffusion framework for Tweedie noise. The noise exponent $p$ describes the variance--intensity relation, while accumulated measurement $ν$ controls the noise level. Together, they define a noise plane that includes Gaussian, Poisson, and Gamma models. The stochastic bridge connects measurement distributions through independent increments, giving denoising a physical interpretation as progressive measurement accumulation. Both the starting and stopping indices can be specified, allowing restoration from an observed measurement level to a prescribed higher level. Measurement superposition yields a shared reverse-mean update, paired with a deviance-based objective for learning the required conditional mean. A latent compound Poisson--Gamma construction enables sampling at intermediate exponents. A single exponent-conditioned network adapts to different Tweedie noise models without separate training for each exponent. Experiments show that exponent conditioning improves cross-exponent robustness over fixed-exponent models. Using estimated exponents, the shared network achieves robustness comparable to an oracle-selected set of five specialist models. Experiments on synthetic images, FMD fluorescence microscopy, and multi-sensor SAR images further demonstrate its effectiveness across different signal-dependent noise regimes.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Image denoising is a fundamental problem in computational imaging, where the objective is to recover scene information from measurements corrupted during acquisition. Classical methods combine an observation model with image priors based on sparsity or nonlocal similarity [ 1 ] . These approaches established effective ways to separate image structure from noise, while subsequent plug-and-play methods incorporated learned denoisers into model-based optimization [ 2 ] . Their formulation requires both a useful prior for the clean image and an appropriate statistical description of the observation. In physical imaging, however, the observation statistics vary substantially across sensing mechanisms. Photon counting produces signal-dependent fluctuations in cameras and fluorescence microscopy [ 3 , 4 ] , whereas coherent imaging introduces multiplicative speckle [ 5 ] . Consequently, a noise level alone is insufficient to characterize the degradation across these different imaging regimes.
blocks.zh: 图像去诺是计算成像中的一个基本问题,目标是从获取过程中损坏的测量中恢复场景信息. 古典方法将一个观测模型与图像前缀结合,基于sparsity或非局部相似性[1]. 这些方法确立了将图像结构与噪音区分开来的有效方法,而随后的插值和游戏方法将学到的除尘器纳入模型优化[2]. 其表述既需要清洁图像的有用前端,也需要对观测结果进行适当的统计描述。 然而,在物理成像方面,各种感知机制的观测统计数据差异很大。 光子计数在照相机和荧光显微镜中产生信号依赖的波动[3,4],而连贯的成像则引入了多种光谱[5]. 因此,单是噪音水平不足以描述这些不同成像系统的退化特征。

blocks.en: Learning-based methods have substantially improved denoising by learning image statistics and restoration mappings from data. Convolutional networks provide efficient inference [ 6 , 7 ] , Transformer-based models capture long-range image dependencies [ 8 ] , and noise-conditioned models allow one network to handle different corruption levels [ 9 ] . Nevertheless, supervised restoration depends on how well the training data represent the deployment conditions, while collecting accurate clean references can be difficult in real photography and scientific imaging [ 10 , 11 ] . Learning from noisy observations reduces this dependence. Noise2Noise uses corrupted training targets [ 12 ] , and Noise2Self exploits noise independence to learn without clean targets [ 13 ] . These methods broaden the available training settings, but their validity and performance still depend on the statistical structure of the observations. Blind restoration also benefits from explicitly estimating the degradation. VIRNet, for example, jointly estimates noise and restores the image under a spatially varying Gaussian likelihood [ 14 ] . Such developments make denoising more adaptive, while leaving the choice of the underlying noise distribution an important modeling decision.
blocks.zh: 以学习为基础的方法通过学习图像统计和从数据中进行恢复绘图,大大改进了消音。 革命网络提供高效的推论[6,7],基于变形器的模型捕捉长距离图像依赖性[8],噪声条件模型允许一个网络处理不同的腐败级别[9]. 然而,监督修复取决于培训数据如何代表部署条件,同时收集准确的清洁参考材料在真实摄影和科学成像[10,11]中可能很困难. 从吵闹的观察中学习可以减少这种依赖性. 噪音2 Noise使用腐败的训练目标[12],而Noise2 Self利用噪音独立来学习,没有干净的目标[13]. 这些方法拓宽了现有的培训环境,但其有效性和绩效仍取决于观察的统计结构. 明目张胆的恢复也得益于对退化情况的明确估计。 例如,VIRNet联合估计噪音,并在空间变化的高斯概率下恢复图像[14]. 这种发展使得发号施令更具适应性,同时将选择基本噪音分布作为重要的建模决定。

blocks.en: A complementary line of research addresses this modeling decision through sensor physics and noise transformations. Physics-based noise models describe the acquisition process and generate realistic training pairs [ 15 ] , while recent physics-informed approaches learn difficult-to-model sensor components from calibration data such as dark frames [ 16 ] . These methods improve the connection between synthetic training noise and real measurements, although adapting them to another sensing mechanism requires a corresponding noise model and calibration procedure. Variance-stabilizing transformations offer another route by reducing signal dependence before Gaussian denoising [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] . Noise2VST extends this idea by learning a model-free transformation from the noisy input and using a frozen Gaussian denoiser [ 20 ] . This demonstrates that a Gaussian denoiser can remain useful for non-Gaussian observations when coupled with suitable adaptation. These approaches focus on modeling or transforming an observation without specifying how its distribution should evolve along a denoising trajectory.
blocks.zh: 一个互补的研究线通过传感器物理学和噪声转换来解决这种建模决定. 基于物理学的噪声模型描述获取过程并产生现实的训练对对[15],而最近的物理知情方法则从暗框等校准数据中学习难以建模的传感器组件[16]. 这些方法改善了合成训练噪声与真实测量之间的关联,虽然使其适应另一种感知机制需要相应的噪声模型和校准程序. 差异稳定转换通过在高斯脱诺前减少信号依赖性[17,18,19]提供了另一种途径. 噪声2VST通过从吵闹的输入中学习一种无模型的转换,并使用冷冻的高斯德诺瓦尔[20]来扩展这个想法. 这表明,在进行适当调整的同时,高斯德诺瓦人仍对非高斯人的观察有用。 这些方法侧重于对观测进行建模或转换,但没有具体说明其分布应如何按照去名轨迹演变。

blocks.en: Diffusion-based restoration makes this trajectory an explicit part of the model. Restoration bridges such as I 2 SB learn processes connecting degraded and clean image distributions [ 21 ] , while diffusion posterior sampling incorporates measurement likelihoods, including Poisson noise, into reconstruction with a diffusion prior [ 22 ] . Beyond Gaussian formulations, Xie et al. construct denoising diffusion processes for Gaussian, Gamma, and Poisson noise with a unified training strategy [ 23 ] . Gamma Bridge further gives the trajectory a physical coordinate through the number of looks, allowing restoration between specified measurement levels for Gamma speckle [ 24 ] . These advances establish both noise-aware diffusion and measurement-indexed restoration, but these constructions treat particular noise laws or discrete families. Extending this perspective to a continuously varying variance–intensity relation requires a common construction that adapts the noise law while preserving the measurement interpretation of the intermediate states.
blocks.zh: 基于扩散的修复使得这个轨迹成为模型的一个明确部分. I 2 SB 等恢复桥梁学习连接退化和清洁图像分布的过程[21],而扩散后采样则将包括Poisson噪声在内的测量可能性纳入重建中,在[22]之前扩散. 在高斯配方之外,谢等人用统一的训练策略构建了高斯配方,伽马,普瓦松噪声的去诺扩散过程[23]. 伽玛 桥梁进一步通过外观的数量给轨迹一个物理坐标,使得Gamma Speekle的指定测量水平之间能够恢复. blocks.en: In this work, we propose p p -Bridge, a unified measurement-indexed diffusion bridge based on the Tweedie family [ 25 , 26 ] . Our starting point is that accumulating independent measurements of the same scene reduces noise while preserving the expected intensity. The Tweedie variance relation μ p / ν \mu^{p}/\nu allows us to apply this principle across different noise laws. Here, p p describes how variance depends on intensity, while ν \nu represents accumulated exposure, dose, or number of looks. These two coordinates distinguish changes in the noise law ( Figure 1 ) from movement along a measurement trajectory ( Figure 2 ). At a fixed exponent, increments that are independent conditional on the clean image connect the measurement distributions into a stochastic bridge.

blocks.en: In this construction, the network predicts the clean signal needed for each reverse update, while exponent conditioning allows its prediction to adapt to the observation’s noise statistics. We evaluate the role of this adaptation through controlled exponent-mismatch and estimation experiments, and assess restoration quality on synthetic images, FMD fluorescence microscopy, and SAR images from multiple sensors.

blocks.en: The main contributions are as follows: 1. We propose p p -Bridge, a unified measurement-indexed diffusion framework for Tweedie noise. Its two noise coordinates have distinct roles. The exponent p p specifies the variance–intensity relation, while accumulated measurement ν \nu controls the noise level. The stochastic bridge connects the corresponding measurement distributions, allowing both the starting and stopping measurement levels to be specified. 2. We derive a shared reverse-mean update from measurement superposition, with a mixing coefficient independent of the noise exponent. A unit-deviance reconstruction objective targets the conditional mean required by this update. A latent compound Poisson–Gamma construction enables sampling of measurement transitions at intermediate exponents. 3. We develop a single exponent-conditioned network that adapts to different Tweedie noise models without separate training for each exponent. At inference, the network uses an exponent estimated from the observation. This shared model achieves cross-exponent robustness comparable to an oracle-selected set of five specialist models.

blocks.en: II-A Diffusion models, bridges and inverse problems
blocks.zh: II-A 传播模式、桥梁和反向问题

blocks.en: Widely used denoising diffusion models [ 27 ] and their score-based formulations [ 28 ] add Gaussian noise according to a prescribed variance schedule. Subsequent work has improved sampling [ 29 ] and network parameterization [ 30 ] . Restoration-oriented methods also redesign the trajectory. For example, ResShift introduces residual shifting to reduce the number of sampling steps [ 31 ] .
blocks.zh: 广泛使用的去诺化扩散模型[27]及其计分配方[28]根据规定的差异表添加高斯噪音. 随后的工作改善了取样[29]和网络参数化[30]。 面向恢复的方法也重新设计了轨迹。 例如,ResShift引入残余转移以减少采样步骤的数量[31].

blocks.en: Restoration bridges connect clean and degraded image distributions. Schrödinger bridge formulations connect prescribed endpoint distributions [ 32 ] , with I 2 SB applying this principle to image restoration [ 21 ] . Other formulations use direct endpoint interpolation [ 33 ] or mean-reverting stochastic differential equations [ 34 ] . More recent developments target spatial adaptation and efficiency. RDBM uses endpoint residuals to modulate noise injection and removal across image regions [ 35 ] , while E-Bridge shortens the trajectory and learns a consistency-based mapping for single-step restoration [ 36 ] . System-Embedded Diffusion Bridge Models incorporate the forward system explicitly, embedding a known linear operator and noise covariance into a matrix-valued SDE under an additive Gaussian measurement model [ 37 ] .
blocks.zh: 修复桥梁连接干净和退化的图像分布. Schrödinger桥配方连接规定的端点分布[32],I 2 SB将这一原则应用于图像恢复[21]. 其他配方使用直接端点内插[33]或中反斜线微分方程[34]. 最近的发展以空间适应和效率为目标。 RDBM使用端点残基调节图像区域的噪声注入和清除[35],而E-Bridge则缩短轨迹并学习基于一致性的绘图,用于单步恢复[36]. 系统-嵌入式扩散桥模型明确纳入前置系统,将已知的线性操作器和噪声共变嵌入一个矩阵值的SDE中,在添加剂的高斯测量模型下[37].

blocks.en: Another class of methods adapts a pretrained diffusion prior to the observation. DDRM uses the singular-value decomposition of the forward operator [ 38 ] , whereas DPS introduces an approximate likelihood score [ 22 ] . DPS supports Poisson measurement noise while retaining a Gaussian diffusion prior. IRBridge transfers pretrained generative priors to restoration bridges by relating processes with a common endpoint distribution [ 39 ] .
blocks.zh: 另一类方法在观测前适应了预先训练的传播. DDRM使用前置运算符的单值分解[38],而DPS则引入了近似概率分数[22]. DPS支持Poisson测量噪声,同时保留一个高斯扩散前. IRBridge通过具有共同端点分布的关联过程,将预先训练的基因前传承到修复桥[39].

blocks.en: Non-Gaussian constructions extend the choice of diffusion distributions. Xie et al. formulate diffusion denoising for Gaussian, Gamma, and Poisson corruption with a unified training strategy [ 23 ] . Learning to Jump uses count thinning and reverse count thickening for generative modeling [ 40 ] , while Star-Shaped DDPM develops non-Gaussian models within exponential families [ 41 ] . In statistical inference, data thinning splits observations from convolution-closed distributions, including Gaussian, Poisson, and Gamma laws, into independent components [ 42 ] . Gamma Bridge indexes a speckle-denoising trajectory by the number of looks [ 24 ] . p p -Bridge extends this measurement-indexed formulation to the Gaussian point and the Poisson-to-Gamma continuum, using a common superposition construction and a single exponent-conditioned network.
blocks.zh: 非古西建筑扩展了传播分布的选择. 谢等人用统一的训练策略,为高斯安,伽玛,普瓦松腐败制定传播代名词[23]. 学习跳跃时使用计数稀疏和反向计数加厚来进行基因模型[40],而Star-Shaped DDPM则在指数家族内开发非Gausian模型[41]. 在统计推论中,数据稀释将观测从包括高斯安,普瓦松,和伽玛定律在内的演化闭合分布分解为独立的组件[42]. 伽玛 Bridge通过外观次数索引一个Speckle-deloising ro轨迹[24]. p - Bridge将这种测量指数配方延伸至高斯点和波森对伽马连续体,使用一个常见的叠加构造和一个单一的可探测条件网络.

blocks.en: II-B Signal-dependent denoising and noise estimation
blocks.zh: II-B 依赖信号的除噪和噪音估计

blocks.en: Variance-stabilizing transformations reduce signal dependence before Gaussian denoising. Representative choices include the Anscombe transform for Poisson data [ 17 ] , with a corrected inverse at low counts [ 43 ] , and the logarithmic transform for speckle [ 19 ] . Noise2VST learns a model-free transform from a single noisy image and combines it with frozen Gaussian denoisers [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 差异稳定化变换在高斯解诺前降低信号依赖性. 代表性选择包括安斯康贝变换(Anscombe transform for Pouisson data [17]),低计时纠正反数[43],对数变换(specle [19]). 噪声2VST从单一的吵闹画面中学习到无模型变换,并与冰冻的高斯德诺瓦人结合[20].

blocks.en: Sensor-specific methods incorporate the statistics of the acquisition process. Photon-limited methods use variance-stabilized nonlocal regression for microscopy [ 4 ] , raw-data networks [ 44 ] , or physics-based sensor noise models [ 45 ] . Speckle methods exploit its multiplicative statistics [ 5 ] through self-supervised networks [ 46 ] or closed-form shrinkage [ 47 ] .
blocks.zh: 传感器特定方法纳入了购置过程的统计数据。 光子有限方法使用差异稳定非局部回归法进行显微镜[4],原始数据网络[44],或基于物理学的传感器噪声模型[45]. Speckle方法通过自我监管的网络[46]或闭式收缩[47]利用其多种统计[5].

blocks.en: Single-image noise estimation is often formulated within a specified noise family. Gaussian noise estimators use patch statistics and covariance eigenvalues [ 48 ] . Poisson–Gaussian fitting uses local mean–variance relations to estimate shot-noise and read-noise parameters from a raw frame [ 3 ] . VIRNet jointly estimates degradation and restores the image under a spatially varying Gaussian likelihood [ 14 ] . Blind2Sound couples noise-level sensing with self-supervised denoising for Poisson–Gaussian corruption [ 49 ] . In p p -Bridge, the estimated exponent p p selects the bridge’s measurement law, while the estimated index ν \nu determines its starting noise level. The two parameters are fitted jointly as the scaling of ν \nu depends on p p .

blocks.zh: 三、结 论 统一的计量索引桥

blocks.en: In p p -Bridge, denoising is modeled as the accumulation of independent measurements of the same scene, which reduces noise while preserving the underlying signal. We use the accumulated measurement amount to index a bridge across Gaussian, Poisson, Gamma, and intermediate noise models. The exponent p p selects the noise model, while the measurement index ν \nu controls its noise level. We first construct this bridge, then derive its reverse update and reconstruction loss, and finally describe sampling and training. Figure 3 shows the network pipelines.

blocks.en: IV Experiments

blocks.en: We evaluate p p -Bridge on synthetic noise spanning the exponent and severity axes, followed by real fluorescence microscopy and SAR data. The experiments examine exponent mismatch and conditioning, compare restoration methods, and evaluate noise parameter estimation and robustness to exponent.
blocks.zh: 我们评价p-Bridge对横跨感应轴和严重轴的合成噪音,然后是真正的荧光显微镜和合成孔径雷达数据。 实验检查了感应性不匹配和调节,比较了恢复方法,评价了噪声参数估计和强性以进行感应.

blocks.en: IV-A Experimental setup
blocks.zh: IV-A 实验装置

blocks.en: Training data. We use a pool of 1,100 1{,}100 clean natural images from BSDS500 and DIV2K [ 53 , 54 ] , with 256 × 256 256\times 256 training crops. Clean intensities are mapped to 𝒳 = [ 0.05 , 1 ] \mathcal{X}=[0.05,1] using the intensity offset. Noisy observations are generated from the corresponding Tweedie model.
blocks.zh: 培训数据。 我们使用来自BSDS500和DIV2K[53,54]的1,100 1{,}100个干净的自然图像,其中256×256256\时256种训练作物. 使用强度偏移法将清洁强度映射到X = [0.05, 1]\ mathcal{X}= [0.05, 1]. 从相应的Tweedie模型中产生噪音观测.

blocks.en: Synthetic evaluation. We evaluate on 64 64 held-out crops with noise exponents p data ∈ { 1 , 1.25 , 1.5 , 1.75 , 2 } p_{\mathrm{data}}\in\{1,1.25,1.5,1.75,2\} and severities η ∈ { 0.25 , 0.5 , 1 } \eta\in\{0.25,0.5,1\} (mild, moderate, and severe). Each fixed-exponent model is tested across all five exponents, with results averaged over three corruption seeds. Comparisons with external methods use p data ∈ { 1 , 1.5 , 2 } p_{\mathrm{data}}\in\{1,1.5,2\} .
blocks.zh: 合成评价. 我们用噪音指数数据评估了64种64种被搁置的作物。 每个固定责任人模式对所有五个责任人进行测试,结果平均超过三个腐败种子。 与外部方法的比较使用 p 数据 {{ 1, 1.5, 2} p { mathrm{ data}}}{ 1, 1.5, 2}} 。 。 。

blocks.en: Real-data evaluation. Noise calibration covers 12 12 FMD fluorescence microscopy configurations [ 11 ] and three SAR sensors: miniSAR, FARAD-X, and TerraSAR-X. Restoration comparisons use three FMD configurations, following the prior protocol, and all three SAR sensors. For each FMD configuration, we use 19 19 fields for fine-tuning over 20,000 20{,}000 steps and one held-out field for evaluation. Dataset-specific preprocessing and calibration are described in the corresponding experimental subsections.
blocks.zh: 真实数据评价. 噪声校准涵盖12个12个FMD荧光显微镜配置[11]和3个SAR传感器:迷你SAR,FARAD-X,以及TerraSAR-X. 恢复比较使用3个FMD配置,遵循之前的协议,以及所有3个SAR传感器. 对于每个FMD配置,我们使用19个字段来微调超过20,000 20{,}000个步骤和一个搁置的字段进行评价. 数据集特定预处理和校准在相应的实验小节中描述.

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics. We report PSNR and SSIM against clean synthetic images or the FMD frame-average reference. The supplementary sampling-budget study also reports dark-region log-RMSE ( Table S2 ). For real SAR, where clean references are unavailable, we report the ratio-image measures ℳ \mathcal{M} [ 55 ] and RIS \mathrm{RIS} [ 56 ] alongside visual comparisons.
blocks.zh: 评价尺度。 我们报告PSNR和SSIM对照干净的合成图像或FMD帧平均参考. 补充抽样-预算研究还报告了暗区日志-RMSE(表S2)。 对于真实的搜索和救援系统,如果没有干净的参考文献,我们报告比例-图像计量标准M\ mathcal{M}[55]和RIS\mathrm{RIS}[56],同时进行视觉比较。

blocks.en: Model and training. We use a UNet with time embedding, containing 15.19 15.19 M parameters for fixed-exponent models and 15.28 15.28 M with exponent conditioning. The conditional model samples p p uniformly from { 1 , 1.05 , … , 2 } \{1,1.05,\ldots,2\} per micro-batch. Each bridge model is trained once for 50,000 50{,}000 steps with global batch size 24 24 , 1,000 1{,}000 warmup steps, and cosine learning-rate decay from 10 − 4 10^{-4} to 10 − 7 10^{-7} . Loss weights are fixed at ( λ rec , λ mom , λ cons ) = ( 10 , 1 , 5 ) (\lambda_{\mathrm{rec}},\lambda_{\mathrm{mom}},\lambda_{\mathrm{cons}})=(10,1,5) . Implementation details are provided in the supplement.

blocks.en: Noise calibration. We compare different noise models by matching their relative noise at a reference intensity. We use μ ref = 0.464864 \mu_{\mathrm{ref}}=0.464864 , the mean intensity of the offset training pool, and define the noise level η \eta as the ratio of noise standard deviation to this reference intensity. The required measurement index is then ν obs ​ ( p ) = η − 2 ​ μ ref p − 2 . \nu_{\mathrm{obs}}(p)=\eta^{-2}\mu_{\mathrm{ref}}^{\,p-2}. (21) This calibration matches noise levels at μ ref \mu_{\mathrm{ref}} . Away from this reference, relative noise increases towards darker regions for p < 2 p<2 , whereas it remains constant across intensities for p = 2 p=2 . Figure 4 illustrates how the noise exponent affects the spatial distribution of relative noise.

Inference and severity transfer. Unless otherwise stated, p p -Bridge uses deterministic sampling with five network evaluations. Models trained at severe noise ( η = 1 \eta=1 ) are also evaluated at moderate and mild noise without retraining. For a less noisy input, sampling starts at its corresponding measurement index within the trained range. For real-image evaluation, calibrated noise-plane coordinates ( p , ν ) (p,\nu) configure the bridge and select the starting point for denoising.

Each column fixes p data p_{\mathrm{data}} , allowing direct comparison with the matched model. At severe noise, applying a Gamma-trained model ( p model = 2 p_{\mathrm{model}}=2 ) to Poisson data ( p data = 1 p_{\mathrm{data}}=1 ) reduces PSNR by 4.40 ​ dB 4.40\,\mathrm{dB} , the largest loss across the three noise levels. The reverse mismatch costs approximately 3.3 ​ dB 3.3\,\mathrm{dB} , showing that the two directions are not equally harmful. Across the mismatched pairs in the p ∈ { 1 , 1.5 , 2 } p\in\{1,1.5,2\} subgrid, the average loss at severe noise is 2.00 ​ dB 2.00\,\mathrm{dB} .

blocks.en: The minimax exponent. When the noise exponent is unknown, we evaluate each fixed-exponent model by its lowest PSNR across the tested noise exponents. Table II shows that p = 1.5 p=1.5 maximizes this worst-case PSNR at severe and moderate noise, reaching 21.339 21.339 and 23.112 ​ dB 23.112\,\mathrm{dB} , respectively. At mild noise, the optimum shifts to p = 1.75 p=1.75 , with 26.336 ​ dB 26.336\,\mathrm{dB} . Thus, an interior exponent offers the strongest worst-case performance among the tested fixed models, but no single exponent is optimal at every noise level. We therefore use p = 1.5 p=1.5 as a fixed-model baseline and next examine whether conditioning on the noise exponent improves robustness across the full range.

The smaller mild-noise gain reflects the stronger p = 1.75 p=1.75 baseline.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: p p -Bridge connects statistical noise modeling with the design of a denoising trajectory. Measurement accumulation provides the common bridge structure, while exponent conditioning adapts the learned prediction to the noise law. The experiments show that this adaptation matters beyond selecting a noise level. Fixed-exponent models lose accuracy under mismatched noise laws, whereas a shared conditional network achieves cross-exponent robustness comparable to oracle-selected specialists. Using estimated exponents leaves this robustness nearly unchanged, and moderate conditioning errors preserve most of the benefit. Results on synthetic images, fluorescence microscopy, and SAR further support the usefulness of the formulation across imaging regimes. Together, these findings support adapting to different Tweedie noise models by making the noise law an explicit condition within a shared restoration model, without a separate checkpoint for each exponent.

Table S3 shows local-ENL sensitivity: at the 40–95 percentiles, fitted slopes span 2.002 2.002 – 2.016 2.016 , close to the Gamma branch’s quadratic variance law.
